The ticket number is PD-4821. I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random.

Hollis gave that number in #central-team on 2026-06-09 and said the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to it. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he could see this himself.

In the reply I also passed on Hollis's caveat from the same message: the import file labels doors E1/E2 while Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that sorted out before anyone reimports, to avoid duplicates.
